title: Europe Travel Guide
summary: A practical guide to Europe for modern travellers, covering iconic cities, seasonal highlights, visa basics, and top experiences across Western and Eastern Europe.
bestTime: April–June and September–October for mild weather and smaller crowds; December for festive markets.

quickFacts.Language: Multiple: English widely spoken in tourism, local languages vary.
quickFacts.Visa: Schengen visa for many travellers; separate visas for the UK, Ireland, and eastern Europe.
quickFacts.Transport: Trains, low-cost airlines, and regional metros are easiest for most routes.

attractions.name: Paris
attractions.summary: The romantic heart of Europe with museums, iconic landmarks, and world-class dining.

attractions.name: Rome
attractions.summary: Ancient history, cathedral squares, and irresistible Italian cuisine.

attractions.name: Barcelona
attractions.summary: Gaudí architecture, bustling markets, and Mediterranean beach culture.

attractions.name: Prague
attractions.summary: Fairytale old town charm, Gothic cathedrals, and affordable city travel.

attractions.name: Swiss Alps
attractions.summary: Dramatic mountain scenery, winter sports, and scenic train journeys.

cultureEtiquette: Learn a few local phrases; politeness is appreciated across Europe.
Respect museum rules and quiet hours in residential areas.
Carry a reusable bag; many countries now charge for plastic bags.
gettingAround: Use the Eurail pass or point-to-point trains for efficient multi-city travel.
Book budget flights in advance for longer routes, but compare total door-to-door time.
Use public transport cards in major cities like London, Paris, and Amsterdam.
sustainability: Choose trains over short flights when possible.
Use refill stations for water in cities with public tap water.
Respect local recycling rules and avoid single-use plastics.

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for Europe?
faqs.a: Most travellers to Europe need a Schengen visa; check country-specific rules for the UK and Eastern Europe.

faqs.q: What is the best time to visit Europe?
faqs.a: Spring and autumn are best for comfortable weather, fewer crowds, and easier booking.

faqs.q: How can I save on transport?
faqs.a: Book trains and budget flights early, and use city transport passes for multiple attractions.
